composition.description: The composition in the format Element:ratio,Element:ratio (e.g., Zr:1,O:2; Ti:0.5,Al:0.5,N:1). Do NOT leave empty.

lattice_parameter.description: Lattice parameters with units, preserving the exact format from the text (e.g., a=5.191, b=5.239, c=5.392; a=b=c=4.05)

space_group.description: Space group notation (e.g., P2_1/c, P4_2/nmc, Fm-3m, P6_3/mmc, R-3c)

number_of_atoms.description: Total number of atoms in the unit cell (e.g., 3, 5, 8, 12). Leave empty if not mentioned

note.description: Additional important structural information not covered by other fields (e.g., m-ZrO2, high-pressure phase, metastable phase)

cutoff_energy.description: Plane wave cutoff energy with units (e.g., 800.0 eV, 520 eV, 400 Ry, 30 Ry). Leave empty if not mentioned.

K_points.description: K-point mesh or sampling scheme (e.g., "6 9 6 9 6", "4×4×4", "8×8×8", "Monkhorst-Pack 6×6×6", "Gamma-centered 4×4×4"). Leave empty if not mentioned.

pseudo_potential.description: Pseudopotential type or name (e.g., "Vanderbilt-type ultrasoft pseudopotentials", "PAW", "USPP", "norm-conserving pseudopotentials", "Projector Augmented Wave"). Leave empty if not mentioned.

Exchange_Correlation_Functional.description: Exchange-correlation functional name (e.g., "GGA (PW91)", "PBE", "LDA", "HSE06", "B3LYP", "PBE+U"). Leave empty if not mentioned.

EDIFFG.description: Energy convergence criterion for geometry optimization (e.g., 0.01 eV/Å, 0.05 eV/Å). Leave empty if not mentioned.

EDIFF.description: Energy convergence criterion for electronic self-consistency (e.g., 2.0×10⁻⁵ eV, 1.0×10⁻⁶ eV). Leave empty if not mentioned.

Hubbard_U_value.description: Hubbard U parameter values if DFT+U is used (e.g., U=4.0 eV for Fe; U_d=6.0 eV, U_p=0.0 eV). Leave empty if not mentioned.

software.description: Computational software package name (e.g., CASTEP, VASP, Quantum ESPRESSO, ABINIT, WIEN2k). Leave empty if not mentioned.

theoretical_calculation_method.description: The theoretical method used (e.g., DFT, DFT+U, DFT-D, hybrid DFT). Leave empty if not mentioned.
